d: Have you ever read the ingredient list of your shampoo? If you haven’t then let me tell you this, it’s scary. There are many toxic chemicals in shampoos which are linked to hair fall, irritation, illness and even cancer. Shampoo is something which most of us use on a regular basis. And if you are unknowingly using a shampoo which is toxic, it is doing more harm to your hair than good. Using such shampoo will gradually weaken your hair and you may face issues like dandruff, hair fall and also diseases.
